name: progressive-interaction
description: Enhance conventional HTML forms with background submission and declared fragment replacement.
markup: Mark enhanced forms with data-progressive-form and data-progressive-target.
Mark the matching response element with data-progressive-fragment and a stable id.
Keep action, method, named controls, validation, and a submit button valid without JavaScript.
Use data-progressive-focus when the replacement should focus a specific descendant.

optionalSteps.name: browser-static-assets
optionalSteps.when: The target has no existing typed browser-code build and serving path.
optionalSteps.prompt: This repo has no client module path. Do you want to apply the browser-static-assets kit before installing progressive interaction?

docs: Document the declared fragment and focus target contract.
Document that history traversal reloads the corresponding server-rendered URL.
Keep the JavaScript-disabled Playwright scenario in the target's browser gate.
notes: Cross-origin, unsupported-method, text/plain, and GET-with-file forms keep native submission.
Failed enhancement retries the same form through requestSubmit instead of trapping the user.
The module uses event delegation so replacement fragments do not need listener rebinding.
